item.title: Traitors US S4 Week 4 Interview w/ Banished Player
item.description: Step inside the castle as Rob Cesternino and Pooya sit down with actress and “Traitors” icon Lisa Rinna to explore her dramatic exit from the castle. With Lisa fresh from the round table, this episode delivers behind-the-scenes perspectives on her strategic choices, shifting alliances, and the challenge of blending celebrity reputation with high-stakes gameplay. Lisa opens up about the balance between remaining under the radar and the risks of being a known face in the reality TV arena.
